errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

communities.description: The requesting user's communities, in preferred sidebar order.

unavailable.description: Communities the user joined whose managing AppView didn't answer in time. A client keeps them in the list and shows that they can't be reached.

main.description: Gets the requesting user's communities, in their preferred order. Communities another AppView manages come from the user's social.colibri.beta.actor.remoteSpace records.

managingApp.description: The AppView that manages the community.

unavailableCommunity.description: A community whose managing AppView didn't answer.
